title: For Unto Us a Child Is Born

questions.question: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:2 (ESV): "The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light;"

questions.question: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given; and the government shall be upon his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:6 (ESV): "and the government shall be upon his shoulder,"

questions.question: And his name shall be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of what?
Of the increase of his government and of peace there will be no what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:7 (ESV): "Of the increase of his government and of peace there will be no end,"

questions.question: The zeal of the LORD of hosts will do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:7 (ESV): "The zeal of the LORD of hosts will do this."

questions.question: But there will be no gloom for her who was in what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:1 (ESV): "But there will be no gloom for her who was in anguish."

questions.question: In the former time he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the latter time he has made glorious the way of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:1 (ESV): "he has made glorious the way of the sea,"

questions.question: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff for his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as on the day of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:4 (ESV): "you have broken as on the day of Midian."

questions.question: For every boot of the tramping warrior in battle tumult and every garment rolled in blood will be burned as fuel for the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:5 (ESV): "will be burned as fuel for the fire."

questions.question: The bricks have fallen, but we will build with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:10 (ESV): "The bricks have fallen, but we will build with dressed stones;"

questions.question: The Syrians on the east and the Philistines on the west devour Israel with open what?
So the LORD cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed in one what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:14 (ESV): "palm branch and reed in one day—"

questions.question: The elder and honored man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:15 (ESV): "and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail;"

questions.question: Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; together they are against whom?
For all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out how?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 9:12, 17, 21 (ESV): "and his hand is stretched out still."

key_verse_text: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given; and the government shall be upon his shoulder, and his name shall be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
